html:
A longtime opposition leader who won Guinea's 2010 presidential election, the first open election since independence, and ruled until he was overthrown on 5 September 2021.

He had opposed Sekou Toure from exile in France and was jailed under Lansana Conte. In office he oversaw the end of the Ebola epidemic and a boom in bauxite mining. In 2020 he pushed through a new constitution that let him run for a third term and won, after protests in which dozens were killed. A year later special forces under Colonel Mamady Doumbouya seized him in the palace, one of a wave of coups across the Sahel and West Africa.
sum: A longtime opposition leader who won Guinea's 2010 presidential election, the first open election since independence, and ruled until he was overthrown on 5 September 2021.
